title: lulynx 梯度范数重缩放（工程启发式）

standard.summary: 在优化器 step 前把每个可训练参数的梯度按 grad/(||param||₂+eps) 重缩放（arXiv:2410.09692），让参数范数小的方向获得相对更大的更新。
standard.effect: 开启后优化器被包上一层梯度重缩放包装器；关闭（默认）时训练与基础优化器逐位一致。范数低于 allora_norm_threshold 的参数（如零初始化的 LoRA B 矩阵）跳过缩放，避免除小数爆炸。
standard.whenToUse: LoRA 训练中觉得不同层收敛速度差异大、想要免调参的逐参数自适应步长时；与任意优化器后端可组合。
standard.avoidWhen: 追求与既有配方位级复现时；已用 Prodigy/D-Adaptation 等强自适应优化器时叠加收益不明、行为更难解释。

standard_en.summary: Rescales each trainable parameter's gradient as grad/(||param||_2+eps) before the optimizer step (arXiv:2410.09692), so directions with a small parameter norm receive a relatively larger update.
standard_en.effect: With this on the optimizer is wrapped in a gradient-rescaling wrapper; with it off (the default) training is bit-for-bit identical to the base optimizer. Parameters whose norm is below allora_norm_threshold (a zero-initialised LoRA B matrix, for example) skip the rescale, which avoids blowing up on a division by a tiny number.
standard_en.whenToUse: In LoRA training when you feel different layers converge at very different speeds and want a tuning-free per-parameter adaptive step size; it composes with any optimizer backend.
standard_en.avoidWhen: When you need bit-level reproduction of an existing recipe; and when you already use a strongly adaptive optimizer such as Prodigy or D-Adaptation, where the added benefit is unclear and the behaviour is harder to explain.

advanced.principle: 当前实现对所有 optimizer-owned 参数应用梯度范数重缩放，不移除 LoRA dropout/scaling，也不保证论文 ALLoRA 的 LoRA-only、per-sample 完整语义。
advanced.intervention: trainer_optimizer_factory.py:_maybe_wrap_allora 在优化器构建后包装；包装器在 optimizer.step 前就地改写 param.grad。与 gradient_release 模式组合时由 flux_trainer_optimization_mixin 分支处理。
advanced.expectedImpact: 各层收敛更均衡，对欠训练的层有提速效果；总体质量提升幅度依赖数据与 rank 配置。
advanced.tradeoffs: 改变了梯度的数值语义，与依赖原始梯度范数的功能（梯度裁剪阈值、梯度监控指标）解释性变差；runtime profile 会记录 wired/default_off 契约便于审计。

advanced_en.principle: The current implementation applies gradient-norm rescaling to all optimizer-owned parameters; it does not remove LoRA dropout/scaling and does not guarantee the paper ALLoRA's LoRA-only, per-sample full semantics.
advanced_en.intervention: trainer_optimizer_factory.py:_maybe_wrap_allora wraps after optimizer construction; the wrapper rewrites param.grad in place before optimizer.step. When combined with the gradient_release mode, the flux_trainer_optimization_mixin branch handles it.
advanced_en.expectedImpact: More balanced per-layer convergence and faster progress on under-trained layers; overall quality gain depends on data and rank configuration.
advanced_en.tradeoffs: Changes the numerical semantics of gradients, making features that rely on raw gradient norms (clip thresholds, gradient-monitoring metrics) harder to interpret; the runtime profile records the wired/default_off contract for auditability.
